subject.title: [Feature]: Redesign Control UI cron page into sidebar-first Automations master-detail

question: Should the recently redesigned Cron Jobs page become a default-pinned Automations master-detail surface, replacing its modal editor and quick-create wizard?
rationale: The request deliberately revises recent owner-authored navigation and Cron UX decisions; neither current code nor VISION.md determines the intended product hierarchy and interaction model.

options.title: Approve full Automations redesign
options.body: Adopt the new name, default pin for unconfigured users, and unified master-detail editor while preserving stored sidebar choices.

options.title: Approve page-only redesign
options.body: Replace the modal and wizard with master-detail while retaining Cron Jobs naming and current default sidebar placement.

options.title: Keep the recent design
options.body: Retain the compact rows, modal editor, quick-create wizard, and customizable More-section approach and pursue only narrower usability fixes.

recommendation.title: Approve full Automations redesign
recommendation.body: Adopt the new name, default pin for unconfigured users, and unified master-detail editor while preserving stored sidebar choices.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent Cron and sidebar direction and authored this specific proposal.
